text: This capstone builds one project across the next three lessons: FeedbackScope, a small service that takes customer feedback text and returns a sentiment score, using a real Hugging Face model loaded inside the container.

It's scoped small on purpose -- one model, one endpoint, one clear job. The point is proving you can take something real through the entire deployment pipeline, not building the most elaborate app possible.

Lesson 23 containerizes and deploys it. Lesson 24 adds a real autoscaling policy, a health check, and a caching decision. Lesson 25 wraps up what changed and how to talk about it in an interview. Every lesson builds on the same running service.

Done means an image that builds cleanly from a Dockerfile you can explain line by line, pushed under a real tag, deployed with a public URL, a wired-up health check, and an autoscaling policy with a stated reason behind every number.
"It works" isn't the bar here -- being able to explain every configuration choice you made is. That's what actually transfers to a real job. Next up: FeedbackScope's first real build.
